estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands pushing a tall bamboo pole into the soil of a vegetable bed, with other poles already standing about 40 cm apart
Close-up of a man's hands placing two or three bean seeds in the soil at the foot of a bamboo pole; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil leaning against the pole
Close-up of a man's hands sowing a new bean seed at the foot of a bamboo pole where no seedling came up, next to poles with young bean plants
Fallen bean flowers scattered on the soil under a green bean plant with few pods
Snow pea plant in a pot climbing a small tripod of sticks, with flat green pods hanging; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the pot
Hyacinth bean vine (Lablab purpureus) climbing a garden fence with lilac flowers and young pods
Peanut plant freshly pulled from sandy soil, with peanut pods hanging from the roots
Freshly harvested baby corn ears, some still in their green husks, on a wooden table
